llm_condensed_answer:
SUMMARY: The change from value type to pointer type in corev1.ServiceSpec.Type will break direct equality comparisons in several files across external-dns, argo-cd, and prometheus. These files contain critical code that compares svc.Spec.Type directly with service type constants, which will fail to compile. Helm and ingress-nginx were not found in the available analysis.

FILES:
- external-dns/source/service.go — Contains switch statement on svc.Spec.Type (lines 601-625)
- argo-cd/gitops-engine/pkg/health/health_service.go — Compares service.Spec.Type == corev1.ServiceTypeLoadBalancer (line 30)
- prometheus/discovery/kubernetes/service.go — Compares svc.Spec.Type == apiv1.ServiceTypeExternalName and svc.Spec.Type == apiv1.ServiceTypeLoadBalancer (lines 230, 236)
- prometheus/discovery/kubernetes/service_test.go — Test helpers set Type: v1.ServiceTypeClusterIP
- cert-manager/pkg/issuer/acme/http/http.go — Returns corev1.ServiceType from challenge solver config
